tips.text: Join a clan whose Bio Lab already researched Catabolyst; you do not need Acrid or Embolist yourself.
Rank Entrati through Mother's bounties while collecting Scintillant, mine Necrathene on the same Drift runs, and fish Flagellocanth last.
Expect about one Deimos evening plus the 1-day build once you have Entrati Rank 2 and a researched clan.
